_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro: Udlala iGolf (Umdlalo wamakhadi) - Umdlali {player_id}. Umgomo: Thola amaphuzu aphansi kunawo wonke kulo mjikelezo owodwa. Uma amakholomu enenani elifanayo, afinyelelwa ku-0. Amanani amakhadi: A = 1, 2-10 = inani elibonakalayo, J / Q = 10, K = 0 Izenzo (sebenzisa amakhethini aqondile): - '[draw]' - Dweba kusuka kumgqomo - '[take]' - Thatha kusuka enqwabeni elahliwe - '[swap X Y]' - Shintshanisa ikhadi elidwetshwe ngesikhundla X (umugqa) Y (ikholomu) - '[discard]' - Lahla ikhadi elidwetshwe

board.drew: Wadonsa: {card} Manje kumelwe [swap X Y] noma [discard] it.
board.took: Uthathe: {card} kusuka enqwabeni yokulahla Kufanele [swap X Y] nayo (awukwazi ukulahla).

options.must_swap: You must: [swap X Y] (cannot discard cards from discard pile)

message.knocked: Umdlali {pid} u-knocked! Umdlali ngamunye uthola ithuba elilodwa.
message.final_round: Umdlali {pid} {reason}! Omunye nomunye umdlali uthola ithuba elilodwa.

invalid.wrong_action: Sebenzisa isenzo esisodwa esifakwe phakathi kwemishayo: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], noma [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Awukwazi ukulahla ikhadi elithathwe enqwabeni yokulahla. Kumelwe ulitshintshe.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Unekhadi elidonswayo. Kumelwe [swap X Y] noma [discard] lona.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Isikhundla esingaphandle kwemingcele. Sebenzisa umugqa 1-{max_row}, ikholomu 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Awukwazi ukushaya ngekhadi eliqoshiwe. Qedela ukuphenduka kwakho kuqala.

summary.full: Umdlalo Uphelile! Umdlali {winner} uyaphumelela ngesilinganiso samaphuzu {score}! Amaphuzu Okugcina: {scores}
